div.div:
فُلَانٌ أَمْلَأُ لِعَيْنِى مِنْ فُلَانٍ (tropical:) Such a one is more satisfactory to my eye by his comeliness than such a one. (TA.) ―
-b2- هٰذَا الأَمْرُ أَمْلَأُ بِكَ This thing is better for thee, and more satisfactory: expl. by أَمْلَكُ [which is said to have this signification]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
